backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing user profile management, fasting schedules, and nutrition tracking with role-based access control. Stores user profiles, fasting windows, and daily nutrition entries (calories, macros, water, protein, weight, vegetables) keyed by Principal and timestamp.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two completed features for replacing logos on login page and dashboard with IMG_8398-1.png token image, mapping to specific files and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including components for dashboard, helix animations, nutrition tracking, fasting timers, i18n support, and styling with green-blue gradient theme.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS with Tailwind layers defining OKLCH color variables for light/dark themes, genome-themed colors, and base styling for body and border elements.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with forced dark mode class and inline script to prevent light flash, loading React app from main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component wrapping app with ThemeProvider, LanguageProvider, and Toaster; displays LoadingScreen with LivSpan token image during authentication/profile initialization, then renders StartDashboard.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Authentication button component using Internet Identity hook to handle login/logout with loading states, gradient styling, and i18n support.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Factor: Interactive card component for health factors along DNA helix with selection states, green-blue gradient text, scale transforms, and connection lines to helix spine.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Fastin: Settings card for configuring intermittent fasting schedule with start/end hour selectors, duration calculation, save/cancel actions, and integration with backend fasting schedule queries.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Interm: Displays the intermittent fasting dashboard panel with current fasting/eating phase status, live timer, progress tracking, daily/weekly summaries, streak counter, and fasting schedule settings for authenticated users.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Nutrit: Provides a nutrition tracking interface where users can log body weight, protein intake, and vegetable consumption, with BMI calculation, progress bars, and integration with fasting schedule data.
frontend/src/components/genome/AnimatedH: Renders an animated SVG DNA double helix background with gradients, glow filters, breathing animations, and connecting base pairs for visual decoration.
frontend/src/components/genome/HelixSpin: Creates a vertical DNA helix spine layout component with animated SVG strands and connecting base pairs, used as a container for vertically distributed content markers.
frontend/src/components/i18n/LanguageSwi: A button component that toggles between English and German languages, displaying the current selection with visual highlighting.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileO: A gate component that prompts unauthenticated users to log in and requires authenticated users to complete their profile (name, birth year, height, gender) before accessing child content.
frontend/src/hooks/queryKeys.ts: Defines centralized React Query cache keys for user profile, fasting schedule, and nutrition data to ensure consistent cache management across the application.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, automatically invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useFastingScheduleQue: React Query hooks for fetching and saving the user's fasting schedule, with toast notifications and automatic cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useFastingWindowTimer: Hook that calculates real-time fasting/eating phase, elapsed/remaining time, and progress percentage based on a configurable schedule, updating every second.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validation.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching and saving today's nutrition entry with automatic cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserProfileQueries: React Query hooks for fetching and saving user profile data with actor-dependent loading to prevent UI flashing.
frontend/src/i18n/LanguageProvider.tsx: Context provider for language selection (English/German) with browser detection and localStorage persistence.
frontend/src/i18n/translations.ts: TypeScript type definitions and translation dictionaries for English and German localization covering all UI strings.
frontend/src/i18n/useI18n.ts: Hook to access the language context for translations and language switching.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system for light/dark modes, genome-themed palette, and helix animation keyframes.
frontend/src/lib/fastingMetrics.ts: Demo helper functions returning mock daily/weekly fasting summaries and streak data for display purposes.
frontend/src/lib/nutritionCalculations.t: Pure utility functions for nutrition calculations including BMI, protein targets, progress percentages, and safe number parsing with null handling.
frontend/src/lib/nutritionGuidance.ts: Analyzes macro distribution (protein, fat, carbs, calories) and returns deterministic guidance keys for i18n lookup based on nutritional balance patterns.
frontend/src/lib/timeFormat.ts: Shared utilities for formatting durations as HH:MM:SS and hours with decimal places for timer and KPI displays.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Utility function combining clsx and tailwind-merge for conditional CSS class name merging.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React application entry point setting up QueryClient, InternetIdentityProvider, and rendering the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/StartDashboard.tsx: Main dashboard page with DNA helix background, factor markers (nutrition, sleep, movement, stress, fasting), and expandable panels for each health factor.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: URL parameter parsing utilities supporting both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence for maintaining state across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom colors (helix theme, sage palette), fonts (Inter, JetBrains Mono), animations (breathe, pulse, glow), and design tokens.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking two completed features for replacing logos on login and dashboard pages with IMG_8398-1.png without modifications.
